Context: 9. T.A. on Temporary Transfer

## 9. T.A. on Temporary Transfer  
[ Swamy's FR & SR, Part-II ]  
1. In all cases of transfers for short periods not exceeding 180 days, the journeys from headquarters to the station of deputation and back will be treated as on tour and D.A. granted for the first 180 days only.  
- GIO (3), SR 114.  
2. Joining time is not admissible. Only actual transit time as for tour allowed. - Rule 4 (1), Appendix-10, FR, Part- I.
3. No advance of pay is admissible.
